reason: This plugin is primarily a UI theme extension for DeepSeek Harness Web, focused on changing interface appearance through client-side CSS, components, and bundled assets loaded at startup, with no explicit backend logic, external integrations, or data-processing behavior in the provided evidence.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的主题插件，安装后会自动加载前端样式与资源以应用“Blue Glass”界面外观。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness Web theme that loads client-side styles and resources on startup to apply the “Blue Glass” interface appearance.

capabilities: Applies a static visual theme to the web client UI via bundled browser-side code
Injects CSS and inlined image/data URI assets for interface rendering

reasons.code: README describes the package as a static profile bundle for DeepSeek Harness Web and lists visual theme elements such as ocean background, glass bubbles, sidebar, and styled components.
Package metadata declares DSH web client injection and lists UI theme/slots runtime injections with immediate loading, indicating front-end-only visual customization.
Repository structure includes cordis.patch.yml and lib/client.js, matching the documented flow where the host side is empty and browser side handles theme injection.

capabilities: Applies a static visual theme to the web client UI via bundled browser-side code
Injects CSS and inlined image/data URI assets for interface rendering
